facts.en: Completed a media operations diploma at Fictional Brackenair College in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构蕨空学院完成媒体运营文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid scheduling assistant at Fictional Meadowtone Radio from 2018-10 to 2021-07.
facts.zh: 2018-10 至 2021-07 在虚构草音广播电台任有薪排程助理。

facts.en: Paid traffic coordinator at Fictional Lanternsignal Broadcasting from 2021-08 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-08 至 2026-08 在虚构灯讯广播公司任有薪播出编排协调员。

facts.en: Builds draft daily programme logs from approved programme times, advertising bookings and continuity notes.
facts.zh: 依据获批节目时间、广告预订及节目衔接备注编制每日节目日志草稿。

facts.en: Checks booked durations and identifies overlaps or unfilled intervals before the log goes for approval.
facts.zh: 核对预订时长，并在日志送审前识别重叠或未填充时段。

facts.en: Matches audio asset codes to the approved campaign versions and records items awaiting delivery.
facts.zh: 将音频素材代码与获批广告活动版本匹配，并记录待交付素材。

facts.en: The duty editor approves the programme log; the playout operator handles live transmission.
facts.zh: 值班编辑批准节目日志；播出操作员负责实时播出。

facts.en: Sends approved timing changes to programme teams and keeps the revision time on the shared schedule.
facts.zh: 向节目团队发送获批时间调整，并在共享排程上保留修订时间。

facts.en: Coordinated log reconciliation for a 2025-12 holiday broadcast week.
facts.zh: 为 2025-12 假日播出周协调日志核对。

facts.en: The booking sheet listed 96 advertising placements, including 12 subsequently cancelled placements.
facts.zh: 预订表列出 96 个广告投放位，其中包含 12 个后来取消的投放位。

facts.en: The available sheet recorded 84 remaining bookings but did not confirm that all were broadcast.
facts.zh: 现有表单记录 84 个剩余预订，但未确认全部已播出。

facts.en: Personally checked campaign version codes and cancellation notes; a colleague reconciled invoice references.
facts.zh: 个人核对广告活动版本代码及取消备注；一名同事核对发票编号。

facts.en: Uses a broadcast scheduling application, asset-code searches and spreadsheet time calculations.
facts.zh: 使用播出排程应用、素材代码检索及电子表格时间计算。

facts.en: Completed an internal introduction to programme-log standards in 2022-02.
facts.zh: 2022-02 完成内部节目日志标准入门培训。

facts.en: Logs last-minute asset substitutions and obtains editor approval before distributing an amended schedule.
facts.zh: 记录临时素材替换，并在分发修订排程前取得编辑批准。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Paperantenna Drama Circle from 2016-09 to 2018-06.
facts.zh: 2016-09 至 2018-06 在虚构纸天线戏剧社做志愿者。

facts.en: For that circle, organized rehearsal notices and collected performers’ availability.
facts.zh: 为该社组织排练通知，并收集演员可参加的时间。

facts.en: Made a personal 6-minute fictional radio sketch in 2024 with 2 friends; personally wrote the continuity links.
facts.zh: 2024 年与 2 名朋友制作个人 6 分钟虚构广播短剧；个人撰写节目衔接词。

facts.en: The sketch was played at a private gathering, with no commercial airtime or audience measurement recorded.
facts.zh: 该短剧在私人聚会上播放，未记录商业播出时段或受众测量。

facts.en: Enjoys designing imaginary station badges and collecting paper collage textures.
facts.zh: 爱好设计想象中的电台徽章及收集纸艺拼贴纹理。

facts.en: Provides end-of-shift handovers covering missing assets, unresolved timing conflicts and changes awaiting approval.
facts.zh: 提供班末交接，涵盖缺失素材、未解决时间冲突及待批准变更。
